title: Event | Jun 27 Hangzhou — How AI Helps Go-Global Brands Expand Worldwide
summary: AI is becoming a key lever for international expansion. Unique Research, with Boolv, Tekan, and Shulex (数里行间), presents A New Engine for Going Global: How AI Powers International Expansion — cases, demos, and discussion on market insight, brand, customer service, and supply
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Event preview · June 17, 2024

AI is becoming a key lever for international expansion. Unique Research, with Boolv, Tekan, and Shulex (数里行间), presents A New Engine for Going Global: How AI Powers International Expansion — cases, demos, and discussion on market insight, brand, customer service, and supply chain. (Recap published as 20240628a069cj00.)

What you’ll get

  • How AI reads global market and consumer signals
  • Product positioning and strategy across cultures
  • AI for customer experience and loyalty
  • Networking with practitioners for partners and deals

Speakers

  • Guo Chenlu (天蓬) — co-founder & CEO, Shulex; ex-DingTalk product lead / founding-team PM. Topic: AI Agent + AI Consumer Insight for Go-Global Brand Growth.
  • Le Cheng (吴春松) — founder & CEO, Tekan (est. Jun 2022); ex-Alibaba senior PM, Intelligent Design Lab / Luban; Taobao content tools / Qinpai. Topic: AI Video Generation × Go-Global Commercialization.
  • Wang Qing — founder & CEO, Boolv; ex-ByteDance B2B multi-line PM, Tencent WeChat Pay senior PM; 0→hundreds-of-millions GMV as founder; CUHK MSc. Topic: Using AIGC to Unlock Go-Global Brand Growth.

Agenda

  • 14:00–14:30 Check-in
  • 14:30–15:10 Guo — AI Agent + consumer insight
  • 15:10–15:55 Le Cheng — AI video × commercialization
  • 15:55–16:35 Wang — AIGC for brand growth
  • 16:35–16:45 Break
  • 16:45–17:30 Roundtable

CN signup channel on ingest; not expanded here. 1 CN image.

— END —
